from.place: Etale scalar/pullback comparison preserves scalar-adjunction units

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPullbackUnit
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map
        ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
          (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology φ)).unit.app K) ≫
      (scalarRestrictionPullbackIso φ f).hom.app ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj K) ≫
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).map
          ((scalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app K) =
      (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ)).unit.app
          (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj K)

title: Etale scalar/pullback comparison preserves scalar-adjunction units
statement: For an arbitrary homomorphism φ:A→B of commutative rings and arbitrary scheme morphism f:X→Y, let S_T⊣U_T be the specified derived scalar extension adjunction [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let a:Lf_A U_Y≅U_X Lf_B be the canonical exact restriction/pullback square [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons], and lambda:Lf_B S_Y≅S_X Lf_A the comparison normalized on K-flat representatives [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. For every K∈D(Y,A), Lf_A(unit_Y,K) followed by a at S_Y K followed by U_X(lambda_K) is unit_X,Lf_A K. No boundedness or coefficient-flatness is imposed.

proof.text: Represent K by a flat-term K-flat complex P. Use the representative normalization of lambda, and the definition of the scalar representative map as the adjunct of the ordinary scalar unit.

Transpose the representative equation through the X scalar adjunction. The geometric resolving comparison is the exact derived counit followed by its homotopy-quotient comparison. The exact derived-adjunction factorization identifies the transpose with the ordinary scalar/pullback square. Its isomorphism is the composite-adjunction conjugate, so its unit identity follows from the triangle identities.
Cancel the invertible resolving comparisons. This proves the unit equality at Q(P). Naturality transports the equality along the representative isomorphism to every K.
